title: Young Mania Rating Scale
instructions: Clinician-administered rating of manic symptoms based on interview, observed behavior, and reported subjective experience.

score.missing_response_policy: HTML defaults every item to 0; interpret only after clinician review of each item

severity_bands.label: Remission
severity_bands.action: Manic symptom burden is in the remission range by this tool's display bands; interpret in clinical context

severity_bands.label: Mild mania
severity_bands.action: Mild current manic symptom burden; consider monitoring, functional impact, and longitudinal change

severity_bands.label: Moderate mania
severity_bands.action: Moderate current manic symptom burden; further clinical assessment and treatment planning are usually warranted

severity_bands.label: Severe mania
severity_bands.action: High current manic symptom burden; assess safety, psychosis, impairment, and need for urgent treatment setting

report.heading: Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS)
report.scoring_note: Scoring: 11 clinician-rated items summed for a 0-60 total; items 5, 6, 8, and 9 use 0/2/4/6/8 scoring.
report.screening_note: Lukasiewicz et al. identified a YMRS severity threshold of 25 for CGI-BP mania marked illness in the EMBLEM cohort and a minimal clinically significant difference of 6.6 points.
